title: Social Choice Foundations for Simulation-Augmented Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the metric proportional justified representation plus (mPJR+) satisfaction rate to ensure that a dynamically selected slate of simulated responses proportionally represents the preferences and viewpoint embeddings of the overall population.

Measuring the proportional representation of diverse simulated viewpoints on contentious political questions (e.g., campus protests, foreign policy) to ensure that minority and dissenting political perspectives are included and not marginalized by mainstream consensus.
